span.p:
Load Balancer (Round Robin)
Application Load Balancer / nginx
No sticky sessions, all servers are stateless

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Redis Cluster (6 nodes)
Master 1 (slots 0-5460) + Replica 1a
Master 2 (slots 5461-10922) + Replica 2a
Session data: 4 KB/session, 100K sessions = 400 MB
TTL: 24h absolute, 1h sliding

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cart Service (Separate Service)
Cart data stored in DynamoDB, not in session.
Session stores only cart_id to reference it.
Rationale: cart can be large and should persist
beyond session expiry.
